result.summary: Disables unconfirmed wallet transaction resubmission when the node is configured with `-privatebroadcast`. The wallet checks this setting and skips re-adding unconfirmed transactions to the local mempool during startup, transaction imports, and scheduled periodic rebroadcasts. Initial broadcasts of newly created transactions remain unaffected.
result.problem: When the wider network drops an unconfirmed transaction from mempools, the local wallet periodically re-submits it to the node's mempool and announces or serves it to peers on request. Users running with `-privatebroadcast` expect privacy protections against origin inference, but serving a locally retained transaction that no other peer holds exposes the node as the sender or receiver over clearnet.
evidence: Commit 6d5450244b: "A transaction that the rest of the network has dropped is then held by this node alone, and served to any peer that asks for it, which marks it as the node's own. Not announcing the re-added transaction does not hide this: any relay peer can fetch anything in the mempool once the next inv round has passed."

PR description points to long-standing origin privacy issues: "e.g. an incoming dust payment triggering your node to rebroadcast 24-36th later over clearnet... see https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/3828 for running broader issue"
result.changed_since_previous: No substantial changes to the approach or mechanism; the logic in `CWallet::ResubmitWalletTransactions` and configuration loading remains the same.
result.card: Suppresses unconfirmed wallet transaction resubmission to the mempool when running with -privatebroadcast. Currently, when the network evicts a transaction, a wallet periodically re-adds it to the local mempool and serves it to peers upon request, identifying the node as the transaction's originator or recipient over clearnet. Skipping resubmission on startup, import, and timer intervals prevents deanonymizing users who opted into private broadcast. Initial transaction broadcasts remain unaffected.

risk.why: A bug could cause unconfirmed wallet transactions under -privatebroadcast to fail to reach the mempool after a restart until manually rebroadcast, but normal broadcast flows and non-privatebroadcast configurations are unaffected.
